Confirmed: these tests expect code in the repo's own folder to run, which 812.1 rules out. The planner's to change.
Confirmed: each named test pins the old triggers or paths the shared design replaces; rerun, they fail.
Confirmed: that test runs without the key secret it names, so 812.5 now rightly stops it.
Already open as [#755](https://github.com/dokima-dev/dokima/issues/755) (first release tag); no new issue needed.
